contextId.description: Present when the binding is context-scoped.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

appliesTo.description: List of trust contexts this policy applies to. Empty array = applies to all contexts (the default policy).

module.description: Rego source code. The maintainer's evaluator entry point is the package's `decision` rule, returning a PolicyDecision.

priority.description: When multiple policies match a request, evaluation order is by priority descending. The first to return a non-`null` decision wins.

bindings.description: The active (contextId, purpose) -> policy bindings that matched the request. Zero entries when the requested purpose has no active policy; the full set when purpose is omitted. Unpaginated — the active set has one entry per purpose, which is small by construction.

appliesTo.description: List of trust contexts this policy applies to. Empty array = applies to all contexts (the default policy).

module.description: Rego source code. The maintainer's evaluator entry point is the package's `decision` rule, returning a PolicyDecision.

priority.description: When multiple policies match a request, evaluation order is by priority descending. The first to return a non-`null` decision wins.

bindings.description: The active (contextId, purpose) -> policy bindings that matched the request. Zero entries when the requested purpose has no active policy; the full set when purpose is omitted. Unpaginated — the active set has one entry per purpose, which is small by construction.

contextId.description: Restrict to bindings in this trust context, for a maintainer that partitions its active-policy map per context. Omitted = the maintainer's default (single-context) scope, or all contexts.

purpose.description: Return the active binding for this decision slot only. Omitted = return every active binding (optionally scoped by contextId).
